easy.def: To promise that you are telling the truth.
examples: I swear I did not eat it.
He swore to tell the truth.
She swears she saw a deer.

more.def: To make a serious promise that you are telling the truth or will do something.
examples: The witness swore to tell the truth.
I swear I will keep your secret.
He swore that he saw lights in the sky.
Do not swear at school.
He swore when he dropped it.
Swearing is not polite.

more.def: To use rude or bad language.
examples: It is rude to swear in front of others.
He swore loudly when he stubbed his toe.
Many schools have a rule against swearing.
Honey is sweet.
The apple was sweet.
I like sweet cookies.

more.def: Having the taste of sugar or honey.
examples: Ripe strawberries are sweet and juicy.
The tea was too sweet for me.
Maple syrup is a sweet treat made from tree sap.
What a sweet kitten!
You are sweet to help me.
She gave me a sweet smile.
It was sweet of you to share your lunch.
The baby has a sweet smile.
She wrote a sweet note to her teacher.
